test_reraise_with_context: test the reraise_with_context contextmanager that appends context messages to raised exceptions
test_add_context: test the add_context function that appends error messages to the context stack
test_nested_reraise_with_context: test nested reraise_with_context contextmanager scopes do not duplicate context messages
test_add_context_outside_contextmanager: test that add_context raises AttributeError when called outside reraise_with_context
test_multiple_contexts: test that multiple add_context calls accumulate context messages in the raised exception
